intro: What I use in real work, what I am learning right now, and what comes next. Each skill links to the project that used it.

learnt.name: Learnt
learnt.text: Used in real work: a paper, a thesis or a running project.

learning.name: Learning
learning.text: In progress now, with a project that needs it.

next.name: Next
next.text: Planned, with a date or a project waiting for it.

domains.name: Medical imaging & physics
domains.text: The core of the PhD: simulating PET/CT scanners, inserting lesions into raw data and measuring whether the numbers hold.

domains.name: Simulation & engineering
domains.text: From microwave ablation and blood flow to a robot submarine: physics models checked against experiments.

domains.name: Programming & ML
domains.text: The languages the simulators are written in, and the deep-learning stack I am training on now.

domains.name: Agentic AI & dev tools
domains.text: Teams of AI agents with human gates: they run studies, build software and keep logs I can audit.

domains.name: 3D & creative
domains.text: The village on the home page and the Kage game: modelled, generated and built with agent help.

domains.name: Lab & fabrication
domains.text: Hands-on work: printed phantoms in the scanner, microfluidic chips, soft electrodes and ex vivo burns.
